component.name: Gnune
component.summary: Browse and play your local music and video collection

description.p: Gnune brings the typography and artwork of the Zune desktop player to Linux. Browse artists, albums and playlists, follow synchronized lyrics, or switch to a compact player while a music video keeps playing.
Discover and subscribe to podcasts, stream or download episodes, choose listening order and resume from Quickplay.
Share music, videos and podcasts with phones over Tailscale HTTPS, including listening progress and phone Quickplay. Sharing requires separate host setup; Flatpak uses its own settings.
Adds visible window controls, a rewind button and refreshed Smart DJ artist suggestions.
Browse and play your music collection on a paired phone, with optional video sharing, local pairing QR codes and remembered sharing settings.
Improves compilation grouping, collection browsing and phone recovery.
